features: Corn Chex Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal is a wholesome and crunchy choice for the entire family. Made from whole grain corn, it's a naturally gluten-free option that’s perfect for a quick and nutritious breakfast. With no artificial colors or flavors, it offers a clean and simple taste that kids and adults both enjoy. This 18 oz family size box is also a great ingredient for making homemade Chex Mix snacks—ideal for parties, road trips, or anytime munching. Light, crispy, and versatile, Corn Chex delivers both taste and nutrition in every bite.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Corn Meal, Sugar, Corn Starch, Salt, Baking Soda. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
